replies.author: PublixEmployee
replies.body:
I don't dig this map all too much.
Don't get me wrong, the map looks great, I just don't like where it is heading in terms of gameplay. 

It'd be nice to see the trees get a bit smaller.
Having them too big could get annoying in the future as it just gets in the way.
And even if you remove that, the void gap would become a tad too big in my opinion. 
That being said, it'd be nice to also see both sides get closer to each other.

 I personally don't like the iron on the front islands, those being there can attract players to go over to it and instantly get it to turn the map into a massive kill farm.  
 It's never really fun to get spawn killed...
  ^Same with the full diamond armor and diamond sword.
  
 I would also like to see the size of the monument island get bigger personally, it being too small can cause it to be too easy to stalemate it.

Oh, and please don't use bone meal to make it look "better." The huge amounts of grass can get annoying for PvP as it gets in your way when you are trying to kill someone at times.

replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body:
I get your points but they sort of confused me..

You said there is a too big void gap between the islands, yet you also said people could get spawn trapped when they go for the iron, even with this "big void gap"... Spawn is on another island so I am unsure how they could get spawn trapped.

There are 11 blocks between spawn island and tree island and then a further 20 blocks between the middle and tree island. When compared to other maps I don't personally think this is too much so unless more people agree with you or a map dev also does, I won't be moving them closer.


I'm working on updating the momument island to add more detail and make them slightly  larger.

I used the bonemeal sparingly as I hate the generic flowers so that shouldn't be an issue.
